sentences.text:
Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy
Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy
 The Honourable Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Writ Petition No.18599 Of 2024
Order :

(ORAL) This writ petition is filed by the petitioner seeking to declare the action of respondent No.4 - the Sub-Inspector of Police, Peddavoora Police Station, Nalgonda District in not arresting the Accused and not conducting proper investigation in Crime No.27 of 2024 registered with Peddavoora Police Station on 15.02.2024 for offences punishable under Sections 417, 420 and 471 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC), as being illegal, arbitrary and unconstitutional.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home,
and perused the material available on record.
3.

Having received written instructions dated 13.07.2024 from respondent No.4, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home submitted that all offences in Crime No.27 of 2024 are punishable with the term less than seven (7) years imprisonment, as such, respondent No.4 issued notices under Section 41A Cr.P.C. to the Accused on 25.02.2024.

Later, respondent No.4 addressed the letter dated 09.07.2024 requesting the District Veterinary and Animal Husbandary Officer,
Veterinary Hospital premises, Manyam Chelka, to furnish the attested documents, which were submitted by Madagoni @ Nallagonda Rajeswari W/o Nallagonda Venkataiah at the time of her appointment as attender and joining orders in Chalakurthy Veterinary Hospital, Peddavoora Mandal to proceed with further investigation.
It is submitted that investigation will be completed and final report/charge sheet will be filed before the jurisdictional Court.
A copy of written instructions is served on learned counsel for the petitioner.
4. In view of the above, no further orders are required to be passed.
The writ petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.

As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous applications, if any, pending in the writ petition stand closed.
______________________ B. VIJAYSEN REDDY, J Date: 15.07.2024 RRK
